title: En Route
program: Louis le Prince International Short Film Competition
description: Form Narrative Premiere Status UK Country Netherlands Year 2019 Running Time 10min Language Dutch Director Marit Weerheijm Screenwriter Marit Weerheijm Producer Loes Komen , Eva Verweij Key Cast Inay Heijblom, Alex Dosljak, Mike Libanon When Inay and her little brother have to join their father on a special trip through the city, she tries everything to cause a delay. She knows that if they arrive late at their destination, she will be rewarded with many, many sweet desserts. A couple walk in an overripe sunflower field. A story that begins where it ends, where everything is said, but where one can’t really let go of the other, where there is still an old familiarity and a new odd stranger.
